probes.description: FORM P3-T5c: a flow declaring trigger {event, condition} runs when that event is published, with no HTTP call. Creating a ShelfLayout publishes ShelfLayoutRegistered; OneFlowOnShelfRegistered (condition $event.id != "") then shows up in the execution history as an OK run, while OneFlowOnShelfRegisteredNever (condition $event.id == "no-such-shelf") never runs. The orchestration rule FollowUpNewShelf listens on the same event and keeps working beside the flow (both fire, by design).

steps.name: the trigger flow whose condition holds ran, the other did not
